- Receiving parent: `17e1a3286a5e8136d1d5dc09da37f33fd1baa100` from the existing #8/#10 integration branch.
- Additional real parents: calendar #19 at `e64fd96ffda52ec571779edfeec609f7b01c3c9f` (including editor #14), and ordinary-action #16 at `480a99bd6de57ff04089975b34b43856da56fdf9`.
- Published receiving tree: `b28e7b706fe67fd4b34111badd581c6bdd2ed4a7`.

The composition preserves parser, storage, policy and backup behavior. Shared-file wiring retains backup and editor bindings, historical fallback durations, reviewed calendar selection and the exact #16 fresh Save/Remove spans. All42 unrelated integrator blobs remain byte-identical. The original #8/#10 receiving owner retains broader integration; this separate child PR leaves that owner's branch unchanged until adoption.

## Verification

201 native tests and the strict TypeScript/Vite build pass. The original five-case #16 browser receiver fails all five controls on the prior composed build and passes all five on this source. Three additional actual Chromium groups verify stale Save and Remove across real backup restoration, calendar refusal of changed selected records, correct explicit recovery, read/quota failures, draft retention and import retry. Calendar actions perform zero saved-data writes; the run records zero application errors and external requests.

Independent source review accepted the exact ordinary-action spans and unchanged remaining implementation. The prior195-test/four-group editor/calendar/backup qualification, its independent source acceptance, and the source-bound failures remain preserved alongside the latest packet.

The complete receiving sources, real downloads, screenshots, test commands and hashes are under `docs/receipts/ordinary-actions-receiving-20261008-b55367d787c4/`, with earlier packets linked there. Serialized-payload reconstruction reproduces the exact191-blob tree before publication.

## Remaining receiving input

Main's separately merged #17 daily-refresh change at `3913697f70a31d73e8fe7d02b686b306830c24db` is outside this frozen composition. Its owner and newer focus work remain intact. This PR qualifies the stated source inputs; the broader owner can preserve that later change during final main integration.

pr22.head: 775a16f651858049dccadf99fec3a80844466ab6
pr22.source_body:
## Find one saved return in a large tracker

Portable backups already support 10,000 saved orders, but the tracker only offered date filters. This adds **Search store or order number** so a user can find a particular return, edit it, remove it or download its individual reminder.

The query matches literal store/number text without case or repeated-whitespace sensitivity, including a copied leading `#`. It combines with All / Due soon / Expired, keeps deadline order and leaves the global counts intact. Clear search restores focus; a separate status shows the displayed count. The query remains in place across ordinary changes and storage retry.

Saved schema and the parser, policy, storage, editor, calendar and backup modules are unchanged. Backup downloads retain the complete tracker. The calendar dialog keeps its existing date-filter initial selection and explicit checkbox review; the tracker explains this scope.

## Receiving and validation

This PR is stacked on **#20 at 7829e56e57ef91dfe8edd5853fd68d6c7890fac0**, for the existing **#8/#10 integration owner**. Their later composition of main's #17 date refresh/focus and the deliberately deferred #6 parser remains separate. No main branch, existing owner ref or deployed site was changed.

- **231 native tests and strict TypeScript/Vite build pass**: all 201 original tests, 22 matcher cases and eight actual-main handler controls. A 10,000-record matcher case checks individual lookup and preserved reference ordering.
- **Six real-browser groups plus the baseline absence/control pass** on installed Mac Chromium 151.0.7922.34. They cover native Escape/clear focus, literal text/optional number, edited-row query departure and draft/identity retention, whole backup/import and unchanged reviewed calendar download, true second-tab removal freshness, and read-refusal/retry at 390px with no overflow.
- All nine transferred browser inputs match before/after execution; there are no browser errors or external requests. The actual phone capture was visually inspected.
- **Independent source review accepted** the exact application source, all 196 leaves and all 188 unchanged original leaves. It separately preserves the #20 receiving boundary and does not claim to have rerun the author's tests.

Source is frozen at local application 1fbd1fc; delivery b24f7c5 has exact tree 7330138b474d68f2f28e1660c70a6a3587499747. The sole later harness change guards fixture initialization on opaque about:blank; application bytes stay exact. Original feature-absence evidence, the corrected temporary optional-number error and the native environment/receiver failures are retained rather than counted as passing checks.

The complete [receiving receipt](docs/receipts/saved-order-lookup-20261008-965d2e86e979/README.md) includes unchanged peer evidence, source/build custody, native logs, both real downloaded fictional artifacts and the phone capture. Source claim: #8 comment 6059410633. Hosted exact-head CI will be read back after publication.
